properties.label_en: Nobadia: Philae to the Third Cataract, until c. 7th century, disputed – strip width along the Nile is a display choice, not a sourced boundary
properties.label_ar: نوباتيا: من فيلة إلى الشلال الثالث، حتى نحو القرن السابع، تاريخ متنازع عليه – عرض الشريط على امتداد النيل اختيار للعرض، لا حدّ موثّق
properties.method: approximate from cited limits; GHA2_CH12. End year 700 = this dataset’s Nobadia era end; merger date not verified. Nile corridor (Natural Earth rivers, PD, buffered 0.3°); the east/west edges are a display convention, no source describes them.
properties.note: Union date disputed: the earliest proposed date is perhaps around 630 (Derda & Łajtar 2019); GHA II gives the alternatives – Qalidurut by the mid-7th century (al-Maqrizi, as reported in GHA II) or Merkurios from 697. 700 is a display placeholder.
